title: Lights on in Clitheroe
headline: Lights on in Clitheroe
caption:
It's Christmas lights switch-on day in Clitheroe! ✨

There's something special about seeing the town light up as the evenings draw in, and our little corner of York Street feels extra cosy this time of year.

If you're heading into town, wrap up warm, wear comfy shoes, and take a moment to roll your shoulders back and stand tall while you enjoy it all.

However you're spending your weekend, we hope it's a gentle one. Your reformer will be ready for you at our Pilates studio in Clitheroe next week.

Will you be at the switch-on? Tell us in the comments 👇

📍 POWR Studio, 9 York Street, Clitheroe
